prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity desktop web application design comp for JevClean, a local AI IMAP mail organizer, in a wide landscape canvas around 1440 by 1000. Render the flat application interface edge to edge, with no browser window, device, desk, perspective or presentation frame. This is an actual useful product screen, not a poster or marketing page. Art direction: light, simple, refined Apple-native-inspired utility; SF Pro style system sans typography with accurate readable Chinese, neutral pale grey-green background #f5f7f6, near-white content #fdfefd, charcoal text #202a25, muted text #596a60, restrained forest green #24634a for primary controls and selected state, hairline borders #dbe3de. Compact ordinary buttons, inputs, select controls and checkboxes with 6-8px corners, generous but deliberate 24-32px work-area spacing, clearly aligned rows, 14-16px body UI text and restrained 24px headings. No gradients, glass, floating dashboard cards, charts, oversized hero typography, decorative photography, fake accuracy claims, or ornamental icons. Existing identity: small green rounded-square letter J followed by the wordmark “JevClean”. Top bar 64px tall: wordmark left, account “user@example.com” and small real green connection indicator “本机运行” near right, a standard “设置” button at far right. Main content is mail RESULTS FIRST; mailbox/API/rules are in a separate settings view and NOT full forms on this screen. All sample mail is fictional; show small “合成邮件示例” in footer.
Use realistic and legible exact labels where possible: page heading “整理邮箱”; analysis scope “分析文件夹” with “INBOX + Archive”, “分析范围” value “最近的邮件”, “邮件数量” value “100”; primary action “开始分析”; checkbox consent line “允许将必要邮件文字发送给 Jev，使用我的 API 额度。分析不会修改邮件。” and a nearby privacy details link. Small enabled-rule summary “3 条规则已启用” and link “管理规则”. Results filters over the list: “动作列表 26”, “不确定 5”, “保留 7”, “全部 38”. List toolbar: checkbox “选择全部候选”, “已选 2 封”, action “执行所选”. Visible latest batch result: “最近一批操作”, “已完成 12 封” with secondary “0 封未完成，0 封待核对”, small controls “核对操作结果” and “撤销最近一批操作”. Sample rows contain normal square checkboxes, a subject, sender, small date/folder metadata, explicit action or state, and one brief reason: “秋季促销，会员专属优惠” / “Offers” / “9月28日” / “删除” / “命中广告推广”; “Your authentication code” / “Example Account” / “9月27日” / “删除” / “验证码已过期”; “开发者峰会邀请” / “Developer Events” / “9月24日” / “删除” / “厂商群发推广”; “Weekly product updates” / “Product News” / “9月22日” / “归档” / “命中每周更新”; “活动报名即将截止” / “Events” / “9月18日” / amber “不确定” / “无法确认截止时间”; “订单付款成功，请保留” / “Store” / “9月16日” / “保留” / “订单记录属于保留例外”. Show two row checkboxes selected in green. Keep action state clear and reasons subordinate, never giant right-side prose. Footer compact links “隐私与本地数据”, “操作日志”, “退出本地服务”.
Composition A: LIST FIRST. No left sidebar and no persistent preview pane. A centered fluid workspace about 1240px wide, 48px side padding. Under top bar is the heading with a one-line explanation. Below is a compact horizontal analysis strip, all folder/range/count controls in one row with the green Start button at right and the consent beneath; do not make this a huge card. Below that a slim subtly green-tinted latest-operation band holds outcome left and verification/undo controls right. Results heading and segmented filters follow, then selection toolbar and a wide, crisp, very readable mail list occupying the majority of the viewport. Rows about 68-76px, with the mail subject and sender on the left and action and concise reason aligned at the right. Main content height around 900px. Use whitespace and typography rather than many nested boxes. This must look like a highly polished practical mailbox organizer.
approval: User selected 方案 A, then superseded it with 方案 B on 2026-10-03
